activity.notes: Lithuanian historiography identifies Mindaugas as grand duke from the fourth decade of the thirteenth century and as ruler of all Lithuania by about 1245. ATLAS uses c.1236 as the conventional approximate accession boundary rather than treating it as an exact enthronement date. His grand-ducal phase ends in 1253 when he was crowned king.

sources.title: Mindaugas — Visuotinė lietuvių enciklopedija
sources.citation_text: The Lithuanian encyclopedia describes Mindaugas as grand duke from the fourth decade of the thirteenth century and king from 1253 to 1263.
